title: Croatian Broccoli Bake
description: A hearty, comforting dish from Croatia, featuring tender broccoli and a crispy cheese topping. This easy recipe is perfect for a relaxing Sunday afternoon.
instructions: Steam broccoli until tender, about 5 minutes. Set aside.
In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Add onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in chicken broth and bring to a simmer. Scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan.
Stir in bechamel sauce and cook until heated through. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
In a separate bowl, mix together Gruyère cheese, Parmesan cheese, and bread crumbs.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange the steamed broccoli in an even layer.
Pour the bechamel sauce mixture over the broccoli. Top with the cheese mixture.
Bake until golden brown and bubbly, about 25-30 minutes.
